correctness.rationale: PASS: For real coefficients a_i, independent centered Poisson(lambda) variables and n>=2, lambda>0, the cumulant generating series yields normalized sixth moment 15+15s4/(lambda s2^2)+10s3^2/(lambda s2^3)+s6/(lambda^2 s2^3). The spike gives the sharp upper U=15+25/lambda+1/lambda^2. Holder power means and zero skewness give the even-n minimum and full balanced-sign equality conditions. For odd n, the proof rules out any zero coordinate by a norm-preserving epsilon split with a negative quadratic term, forces signs of both types, and uses strict convexity of q(x)=6x^4/lambda^2+60x^2/lambda+60s3 x to force exactly one positive and one negative level. Directly verified the derivative identity with cubic P_{k,l,lambda}(t), its unique >1 root for k<l, and the finite min over all k=1..(n-1)/2; independent rational Bell-recursion and sample root comparisons corroborate. The odd min is an explicit finite algebraic prescription, NOT an asserted universal winning multiplicity.
